memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient presents with osteoporosis and stage 3 chronic kidney disease.
She reports occasional mild back pain, no dyspnea, and normal urinary output. On exam BP 138/86 mmHg, BMI 27 kg/m2, lungs clear, no joint deformities. She has never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable. Plan to check renal function, bone markers, and vitamin D before initiating osteoporosis therapy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: telmisartan 40 mg OD; dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; furosemide 20 mg OD; sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (0.6-1.2); eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60); urine ACR 45 mg/g (<30); haemoglobin 12.4 g/dL (12-16); serum calcium 9.1 mg/dL (8.5-10.5); serum 25-OH vitamin D 18 ng/mL (30-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Stable osteoporosis and CKD.
She notes improved back pain after analgesics, no orthopnea, mild ankle swelling. BP 142/90 mmHg, trace pedal edema, lungs clear. Never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler; technique not applicable. Continue current CKD meds, increase furosemide for edema, recheck labs.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: telmisartan 40 mg OD; dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; furosemide 40 mg OD; sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.25 mg/dL (0.6-1.2); eGFR 50 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60); urine ACR 38 mg/g (<30); haemoglobin 12.6 g/dL (12-16); serum calcium 9.2 mg/dL (8.5-10.5); serum 25-OH vitamin D 20 ng/mL (30-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoporosis now requiring treatment; CKD stable.
She reports occasional back discomfort, denies dyspnea. BP 140/88 mmHg, no edema, lungs clear. Never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler; technique not applicable. Initiate alendronate and calcium/vitamin D, continue CKD regimen, schedule DEXA.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: alendronate 70 mg once weekly; calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3 800 IU daily; telmisartan 40 mg OD; dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; furosemide 40 mg OD; sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: DEXA lumbar spine T-score -2.6; femoral neck T-score -2.1. Serum calcium 9.3 mg/dL (8.5-10.5); serum 25-OH vitamin D 22 ng/mL (30-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoporosis on treatment, CKD stage 3 stable.
She denies new pain, reports good adherence to meds, no dyspnea. BP 138/86 mmHg, no edema, lungs clear. Never smoked; pack-years 0. No inhaler; technique not applicable. Continue alendronate, calcium/vit D; consider lowering telmisartan if BP trends low.
